subject.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve active connections across runtime reloads

question: Should this production-only runtime repair land first, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110754 rebased to retain only its distinct QA changes?
rationale: The two active member-authored PRs overlap on the same runtime correction, and selecting the landing order determines which branch should carry the canonical production implementation.

options.title: Land the focused runtime repair first
options.body: Merge this narrow production fix after normal maintainer review, then rebase the broader PR and remove the duplicated runtime changes.

options.title: Use the broader PR as the canonical repair
options.body: Close or supersede this branch only after the broader PR is confirmed clean, retains equivalent runtime coverage, and is selected for landing by a maintainer.

recommendation.title: Land the focused runtime repair first
recommendation.body: Merge this narrow production fix after normal maintainer review, then rebase the broader PR and remove the duplicated runtime changes.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr introduced the runtime-context controller model and authored both related repairs, making them the strongest available routing candidate for consolidating the branches.
